title: UOP-family reconstruction · EVEdvEU
note: Original RoLaMGAS UOP-family reconstruction: 27 May 2034 launch, C3 23.1, explicit DSM between Earth encounters. The report publishes only total DSM and approximate flight time, not its flyby/burn dates. Sun-only Lambert/Kepler arcs join at planet centers. Inferred flyby altitudes pass asymptotic speed/turn checks; closest approaches are not finite-radius resolved. Capture and finite-patch export corrections are excluded. Use the exact desktop handoff for a finite-radius Celestia export.
